name: GEE Ltd
tagline: Micro-cap welding-consumables maker with a weak multi-year return record, a Q4 FY26 turnaround, ~44% of promoter holding pledged and rising working-capital days -- not a 10x/100x candidate
business_overview: GEE Ltd manufactures welding consumables (electrodes, wires, fluxes) and allied welding equipment, supplying fabrication, infrastructure, shipbuilding and general engineering customers. It competes with larger players such as Ador Welding and ESAB India.
fundamentals_table: Q4 FY26 described by external analysts as a 'stellar turnaround' but with persistent structural concerns
fundamentals_narrative: The trailing record is weak -- ~3% three-year ROE, ~8% five-year sales CAGR, and working-capital days that have nearly doubled. Q4 FY26 showed a sharp profit turnaround, but on a commodity-ish, cyclical welding-consumables base with no evident moat. At ~3.2x book with ~44% of promoter holding pledged, both valuation and governance argue against an asymmetric thesis.
